overview.description: The Northern Trust Credit-Scored US Corporate Bond ETF (SKOR) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund tracks an index of intermediate-maturity, investment-grade corporate bonds that are selected and weighted by fundamental factors. SKOR was launched on Nov 12, 2014 and is issued by Northern Trust.
